explication: Frame is a native desktop media-conversion application: users add media, inspect sources, configure output and processing, preview edits, then run queued FFmpeg jobs and follow progress. The map includes the shared conversion core and preview engine, plus the documented signed-manifest updater. Major UI and settings capabilities are represented at their existing source paths. Several subsystem links are dashed because the relevant implementation excerpts were not sampled; solid links are limited to documented or indexed references.
